policy: Verde is a consumer/implementation and may provide leads. It is never promoted over canonical ProgBase EXE, raw Portmon/LOGNOVO, or independently reproducible Atlas evidence.

atlas_proven.modify_map_refs: separate ActionAutoCalRifExecute @ 0x005187A0; not a 0x24 mode wrapper

findings.implication: Never import tests/fixtures/progbase-autocal-action-map-v1.json from Verde as native truth. The shifted product mapping is consistent with an operator selecting a gas reset while 0x04 (canonical Reset All) produces a broad reset.

findings.verde_claim: AutoCal presentation/update cadence scoped to 75 ms.
findings.atlas_proven: Native ProgBase AutoCal scheduler is configuration-driven: refresh_time_ms, default 300 ms, DFM range 200..2000 ms; force-refresh paths can bypass the interval.
findings.implication: 75 ms may remain an OMEGAS HMI choice, but must not be described as native ProgBase scheduler parity.

findings.verde_claim: Expose Z1..Z4 as OK/FALTA and mark AGORA from CurrentBand.
findings.atlas_proven: ACQUIRED_ZONES_PETROL/GAS drive acquisition areas; CurrentBand is a separate series derived from live MAP and MNFLD_PRESS_THD.
findings.implication: The Verde UI presentation is compatible with native semantics if synthetic sparse-zone test data remains explicitly visual-only.

findings.verde_claim: Persistent Curve K backup/restore, one-touch recovery and restore reason/audit.
findings.atlas_proven: Native Reset K Factor is a separate ECU-backed path: ActionResetKFactorExecute writes every MUL_ACT[i] = 1.0 then refreshes.
findings.implication: Backup/restore is a valuable OMEGAS safety feature, but it is not native ProgBase behavior and must not become a scientific oracle.

findings.verde_claim: Destructive AutoCal resets interlocked; pre-mutation backup required/fail-closed.
findings.atlas_proven: Reset All 0x04 has a captured broad destructive effect; selective firmware effects of 0x01/0x02/0x08 are not observed in supplied Portmons.
findings.implication: Fail-closed interlock is justified as product safety. The reason must be framed as safety under bounded firmware evidence, not as a ProgBase UI feature.

findings.verde_claim: AutoCal focus shell, larger plot, collapsed technical regions, compact recovery bar.
findings.atlas_proven: No native semantic claim depends on these layout choices.
findings.implication: Useful for product refinement; outside Atlas scientific authority.

conclusion.rule: When Verde and Atlas disagree about original ProgBase behavior, canonical EXE/log evidence wins.
